paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores from a dataset of vaccine-related sentiments. The x-axis, labeled "Polarity scores," ranges from -1.1 to 0.6 and employs a linear scale, with tick intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled "Counts," extends from 0 to approximately 8000, utilizing a linear scale with tick intervals of 400. A single blue line represents the distribution of polarity scores, beginning at a count of approximately 100 at x = -1.1 and reaching a peak count of approximately 6800 at x = -0.2. The line then decreases, reaching a minimum count of approximately 200 at x = 0.2, and gradually rises back up to a count of approximately 1700 at x = 0.6.
